rows.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning, demonstrate its inadequacy, and develop a better alternative?
rows.reason: The project is now focused on the intersection of epistemic transparency (Equity Bias) and potential automation. The next step is to investigate if existing prompt-engineering or agentic-flow patterns approximate the 'Equity Archaeology' methodology.
rows.title: Meta-Reasoning and Assumption Correction
